$comment: Pinned model/provider configuration for the PyJWT bounded-task rule-generation pilot (Arm C initial proposals). Consumed by experiments/run_pyjwt_pilot.py and the dev console. Amended 2026-09-24 (protocol v0.5.0) before any model call: thinking/output-token handling, execution gate, cost wording.
status: configured, not yet executed -- live calls require the operator's --confirm-free-tier assertion (protocol.md §12)
amendment_note: 2026-09-10: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -> gemini-3.7-flash (zero-cost constraint). 2026-09-24: max_output_tokens 1024 -> 8192 and thinking_config added, because Gemini 3.x thinking tokens count toward maxOutputTokens and a 1024 cap risked empty/truncated output; evidence packet v0.2.0 targets molt.rule.v2. No model output had been observed before either amendment.
scope: PyJWT 1->2 bounded task only. SQLAlchemy and Pydantic pilot generation configs are not decided by this pass.
api: Google Generative Language API (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.7-flash:generateContent), x-goog-api-key authentication
model_id_pinning_note: Model id 'gemini-3.7-flash' listed with a Free Tier on https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-09-24). Hosted models can change without notice; modelVersion is recorded per response.
why_this_model: Listed with a Free Tier on the official pricing page (checked 2026-09-24), satisfying the zero-monetary-cost constraint when the key's project has no billing account.
Reports usageMetadata token counts on each response; any field it omits is recorded as unavailable, not zero.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Requires paid billing and a funded API account; rejected under the zero-monetary-cost constraint.
Requires paid API credits or billing setup; rejected under the zero-cost constraint.

request_parameters.temperature_caveat: Temperature 0 reduces variance but does not guarantee bit-identical hosted output across distributed inferences.
request_parameters.max_output_tokens_rationale: Thinking tokens count toward maxOutputTokens on Gemini 3.x; 8192 leaves room for low-level thinking plus a ~300-800 token rule bundle. finishReason=MAX_TOKENS is recorded as a truncated, invalid proposal.
request_parameters.thinking_config_note: Gemini 3.x exposes thinkingLevel (low/medium/high) rather than a disable switch; 'low' bounds reasoning spend. If the API rejects this field the request fails with a permanent 400, which the runner records and does not retry.

caching_policy.caching_status: No explicit context cache is created. Any implicit caching the provider applies is recorded from usageMetadata.cachedContentTokenCount when reported; it is not controlled.

price_schedule.tier: Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier

quotas.verification: UNVERIFIED: copied from the 2026-09-10 draft; actual Free Tier rate limits are per-project and shown in AI Studio. Used only to space requests.

price_schedule.note: Free Tier pricing applies only if the API key's Google Cloud project has no billing account linked. A key inherits its project's billing status (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing), which the API does not expose; hence the runner's --confirm-free-tier gate.

generation_replicates_rationale: Policy value (not empirically derived): the smallest count that can distinguish a one-off from repeatable generation behaviour. Registered as the affordable minimum for the M0 pilot.
repair_trajectory_policy: Registered for M5, NOT executed by the M0 runner: one generation replicate = one trajectory of up to 5 sequential proposals; budgets 1/2/3/5 are read off prefixes of that trajectory.

retry_and_timeout_policy.never_retried: HTTP 400/401/403/404 and other permanent 4xx; the run stops and records the error
retry_and_timeout_policy.semantic_vs_transport: A malformed/invalid/truncated JSON response is a used proposal, never a free transport retry.
